1835:54.note: 1835 prints 'Jesus, mighty King of Zion'; 1841 and 1985 (#234) print 'King in Zion'. Same text (JSP transcriptions; Gospel Library).

1985:240.key: know then that every soul is
1985:240.note: 1985 'Know this, that ev'ry soul is free' is 1835/1841 hymn 1 'Know then that every soul is free'; 1985 credits the text 'Anon., ca. 1805, Boston', consistent with an 1835 source.

1985:119.key: come ye that love the lord
1985:119.note: 1985 'Come, we that love the Lord' credits Isaac Watts; 1841 hymn 16 'Come ye that love the Lord' is Watts's first line before later editors changed it.

1985:109.key: the lord my pasture shall prepare
1985:109.note: 1985 'The Lord my pasture will prepare' credits Joseph Addison (1672–1719); 1841 hymn 98 'The Lord my pasture shall prepare' is the same Addison text.

1985:79.key: with all my powers of heart
1985:79.note: 1985 'With all the pow'r of heart and tongue' credits Isaac Watts; 1841 hymn 85 'With all my powers of heart and tongue' is the same Watts text.
